tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

content.text:
I looked up nothing in PropBank: none of the decisions here turned on how a predicate is defined.

# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((root :depends-on s4t)
               (s4t :contained s4s)
               (s4t :contained s4y)
               (s4t :contained s4d)
               (s4s :after s4z)
               (s4z :before s4y2)
               (s4z :after s4r)
               (s4r :after s4l2))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s4d)
            (author :full-affirmative s4s)
            (author :full-affirmative s4y)
            (author :full-affirmative s4z)
            (author :full-affirmative s4y2)
            (author :full-affirmative s4r)
            (purpose :full-affirmative s4l2))
    :coref ((s1h :same-entity s4f)))

These choices are judgement calls and may differ from the gold annotation:

- **The date:** 2011 is an absolute date, so it depends on `root`. The damage (损毁), the tsunami being set off (引发) and the "led to" event (导致) are placed inside 2011.
- **Order of events:** the cooling system's operation (运作) comes before it stopped (停止). The stop comes after the damage. The seawater injection (注入) comes after the stop, and the purpose clause, direct cooling (冷却), comes after the injection.
- **The earthquake and tsunami:** I gave them no temporal relation of their own. They are named-entity or entity nodes in the graph and have no `:aspect`. If the gold annotation treats them as events, the earthquake (`s4e`) would also be placed inside 2011.
- **The purpose clause:** for the direct cooling I used the `purpose` constant as its modal parent, which the guideline allows. The other option was `(s4r :unspecified s4l2)`, with the injection as its parent.
- **Coreference:** the Fukushima Daiichi plant (`s4f`) is the same plant as 核电站 in sentence 1 (`s1h`). Sentences 2 and 3 don't mention the plant, so `s1h` is the closest earlier mention.
